description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketService's TransferBasketAsync method, focusing on scenarios like transferring anonymous basket items, handling non-existent baskets, and cleanup after transfer.

classes.name: TransferBasket
classes.description: Unit test class for BasketService's transfer basket functionality, including multiple test cases simulating various basket transfer scenarios.

methods.name: InvokesBasketRepositoryFirstOrDefaultAsyncOnceIfAnonymousBasketNotExists
methods.description: Verifies that FirstOrDefaultAsync is called once when anonymous basket does not exist.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketItemsWhilePreservingExistingUserBasketItems
methods.description: Tests transferring items from anonymous to user basket and verifies the merged result.

methods.name: RemovesAnonymousBasketAfterUpdatingUserBasket
methods.description: Ensures the anonymous basket is deleted after its items are merged into the user basket.

methods.name: CreatesNewUserBasketIfNotExists
methods.description: Checks that a new basket is created for a user if none exists during transfer.
